2645-3430-3664-4644.easyPrerequisites: Tidewater Minion doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-3664-4644.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1580-4871-5670-6634.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1580-4871-5670-6634.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Al Bhed Salvagers and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1829-1981-2415-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2438-4446.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
1981-2415-2438-4446.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Relic Vial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

338-2060-3490-3910-7824.easyPrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Crystalline Crawler.
338-2060-3490-3910-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
338-2060-3490-3910-7824.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-804-1619-3734.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-804-1619-3734.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Sakashima the Impostor and Phyrexian Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-804-1619-3734.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1417-2292-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
1417-2292-2946-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2685-3197-4321-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-3197-4321-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more counters on it

145-687-4693-6099.notablePrerequisites:
There are three removable counters among creatures you control excluding the first three +1/+1 counters on Mossborn Hydra.
You control at least three enchantments.
145-687-4693-6099.description:
Activate Serra's Sanctum by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Serra's Sanctum.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Serra's Sanctum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Serra's Sanctum enters, Mossborn Hydra triggers, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
145-687-4693-6099.notes: The prerequisite can be waived if Mossborn Hydra has six or more counters on it.

2769-5147-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
2769-5147-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Hanweir Garrison as attackers.
Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4659-4715-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Prized Statue.
When Prized Statue enters, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Treasure and Prized Statue, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Prized Statue triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Treasure, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

3220-5256-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
3220-5256-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Golgari Germination and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

539-4657-4893.notablePrerequisites: You control two creatures excluding Magus of the Candelabra that do not have summoning sickness.
539-4657-4893.description:
Activate two creatures other than Magus of the Candelabra by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {1} due to Training Grounds and tapping it, untapping it and the two other creatures.
Repeat.

2366-3322-5702-6968.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3322-5702-6968.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nikya of the Old Ways triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

5963-7009-7068.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
5963-7009-7068.description:
Activate Marvin using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Baboon Spirit by paying {3}{U}, exiling Marvin.
At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, returning Marvin from exile to the battlefield
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

567-3490-4017-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-3490-4017-4050.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-1414-1879.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1170-2350-5078-6979.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using The Fourth Doctor this turn If Sensei's Divining Top is on top of your library.
1170-2350-5078-6979.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, and The Fourth Doctor triggers if you had cast Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking The Fourth Doctor.
Resolve the Fourth Doctor trigger, if applicable, creating a Food token.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more charge counters on it

1978-3007-4563.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1978-3007-4563.description:
Animate Everflowing Chalice using Toymaker.
Activate Everflowing Chalice by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Everflowing Chalice.
Repeat from step 2.

2459-5220-5686-6900.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Rograkh
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Rograkh from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Rograkh from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

465-3499-3742-4251-4452.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

997-4484-4871-5643-6709.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
997-4484-4871-5643-6709.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
997-4484-4871-5643-6709.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1496-3490-4050-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
1496-3490-4050-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Verdant Sun's Avatar indestructible.
1496-3490-4050-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

147-3645-5231.description:
Cast Black Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{B}
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Black Sun's Twilight.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Black Sun's Twilight
Resolve the Black Sun's Twilight copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2232-4444-5659.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nontoken nonartifact Lhurgoyf.
You have at least one nonartifact Lhurgoyf creature card in hand.
2232-4444-5659.description:
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding a nonartifact Lhurgoyf card.
Disa the Restless' first ability triggers, putting the discarded Lhurgoyf from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When the Lhurgoyf enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning another nontoken nonartifact Lhurgoyf from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Noose Constrictor ability from step 1, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2092-3371-4896.notablePrerequisites:
Codie does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 3 or greater.
2092-3371-4896.description:
Activate Codie by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate High Alert by paying {2}{W}{U}, untapping Codie.
Repeat as desired, skipping step 2 on the final iteration.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, cast any spell by paying its mana cost, reduced by the {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} added in step 1.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and/or sorcery card in your hand as mana permits, and on subsequent turns.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

1031-1749-3556-3817-4074.notablePrerequisites: You have not copied a spell using Chandra's ability this turn.
1031-1749-3556-3817-4074.description:
Activate Vampire Hexmage by sacrificing it, removing all counters from Invasion of Arcavios.
Invasion of Arcavios triggers, causing you to exile it and cast it as Invocation of the Founders.
Activate Chandra's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, adding {1}{W}.
Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, targeting Invocation of the Founders.
Chandra and Invocation of the Founders trigger, copying Flicker twice, with one copy targeting Chandra and the other targeting Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the first Flicker copy, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the second Flicker copy, blinking Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Vampire Hexmage to the battlefield from your graveyard and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the original Flicker, blinking Invocation of the Founders, causing it to enter the battlefield as Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1755-5203.description:
Activate Door to Nothingness by paying {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and tapping it, targeting yourself.
Holding priority, cast Radiant Performer by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Radiant Performer enters the battlefield, copying Door to Nothingness' ability for each opponent.
Resolve each copy of Door to Nothingness' ability, causing each opponent to lose the game.

1283-1987-2427-3227.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.

738-1969-3652-5256.description:
Sacrifice Ornithopter to Altar of Dementia.
Grave Pact triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Ornithopter to your hand.
Resolve Altar of Dementia's ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
